units.source_text: 古歌：“谷里无天日，春来总不知。

en.t: An old poem says: "In the valley village, no sunlight reaches, so when spring comes, one never knows.

units.source_text: 花开何足喜，早落不须悲。”

en.t: Why rejoice when flowers bloom, and why grieve if they fall early?"
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 源氏嫌最后一句讥讽他，故下文云云。

en.t: Genji disliked the last line because he felt it mocked him, which is why the following passage says what it does.
